non_interference.rule: Mandate correction MUST NOT redesign, reopen, replace, weaken, or couple new dependencies into the completed conveyor. Conveyor remains transport/state/evidence infrastructure only.
non_interference.mutation_boundary: Mandate changes occur in office mandate/control and action execution layers. Existing commercial state machine, durable claims, receipts, minute transport, dedupe and single-writer routing remain intact.

iSCOPE.reason_for_existence: Turn external opportunity space into verified, deduplicated, evidence-backed qualified commercial opportunities.
must_not: send duplicate initial outreach under PRI ownership

PRI.reason_for_existence: Convert qualified commercial opportunities into commercial outcomes and income.

MASTER_CONTROL.reason_for_existence: Govern and consolidate execution without becoming a competing commercial writer.

MANAGERS.reason_for_existence: Keep assigned workers true to mandate and surface/remediate execution drift.
owns: issue corrective direction within existing authority
must_not: block mandated work over non-authoritative inference

CRITIC.reason_for_existence: Falsify claims and commercial execution before false state or harmful direction becomes authoritative.
must_not: become a builder or commercial owner
stop authorized execution merely because context is incomplete when mandate is clear

OVERDRIVE.reason_for_existence: Transport, preserve, route and evidence commercial work so office execution cannot silently disappear.

invariants: iSCOPE owns pre-handoff; PRI owns post-handoff
support surfaces route/support rather than create parallel commercial ownership
realized revenue is zero until payment evidence exists
mandate correction may not regress a working capability
FULL OPPORTUNITY LEDGER != SIGNAL/CLAIM ROUTING SUBSET
provider/session/plan loss changes executor availability, not mandate

current_evidence.iSCOPE: Cherry One qualified and handed to PRI with durable receipt.
current_evidence.PRI: LAVDM buyer response was acted on externally; Gmail action and ledger receipt exist.
current_evidence.OVERDRIVE: Completed successful no-stagnation run with durable READY claims.
current_evidence.MASTER_CONTROL: Mandate/control intent is historically established, but no current independent execution receipt was recovered in this verification.
current_evidence.MANAGERS: Manager mandate is established from accepted operating control, but no current independent manager heartbeat/receipt was recovered in this verification.
current_evidence.CRITIC: Critic checks are embedded in OVERDRIVE evidence adapters; full independent Critic mandate execution is not established by those checks alone.

verification.rule: Do not report a worker as executing its full mandate without current attributable evidence. Preserve mandate and mark evidence gap rather than infer.

authoritative_commercial_inputs.rule: Recover these before commercial reasoning. Signals/claims are routing subsets; they MUST NOT be treated as the full commercial inventory.

commercial_autonomy.rule: iSCOPE discovers from capability and demand, not only from predefined category labels or Owner suggestions.
reasoning_paths: CAPABILITY -> NEW APPLICATION -> POSSIBLE PAYER -> EVIDENCED DEMAND -> OPP-ID
MARKET SIGNAL -> REQUIRED OUTCOME -> CAPABILITY MATCH/COMBINATION -> EVIDENCED DELIVERABLE -> OPP-ID
OBSERVED ORGANIZATION PROBLEM -> AMX SOLUTION/RESULT -> CREDIBLE BUYER -> DIRECT-SALE OPP-ID
commercial_autonomy.category_semantics: Known opportunity categories are a search floor, never an ontology, quota, pacing rule, or ceiling.
commercial_autonomy.derived_capability_gate: Before external representation, bind the exact capability combination to evidence or an authorized synthetic/demo proof; preserve UNKNOWN/HOLD for unsupported portions.

inventory_truth.invariant: FULL_LEDGER != ROUTING_SUBSET. A record absent from current signals/claims is not thereby inactive, closed, or outside PRI review.
inventory_truth.required_action: PRI classifies the full due/READY/relevant ledger, reconciles routing subsets, and persists any consequential routing correction without duplicating outreach.

iSCOPE.semantics: minimum floor when credible supply exists, never cap; no forced qualification quota

PRI.semantics: act on top 5 executable qualified opportunities or ALL if fewer; five is floor, never cap; evidenced WAITING does not park other work

performance_floors.speed_rule: Accuracy, evidence, authorization, fit and dedupe outrank speed. Do not optimize for finishing first.

payment_rail_truth.rule: Payment methods are additive and non-exhaustive. Recover authoritative rail inventory before rejecting an opportunity for payment incompatibility.
payment_rail_truth.incomplete_inventory_semantics: PARTIAL rail inventory is a recovery task, not evidence that unlisted rails do not exist.
payment_rail_truth.program_bound_wallets: Program-provided/bound wallets or accounts are a separate onboarding case and must not be rejected merely because they differ from Matrix-held rails.
payment_rail_truth.secrets: Never persist or expose private keys, seed phrases, recovery material or credentials in commercial state.

executor_continuity.rule: MODEL/PROVIDER/SESSION/PLUS ACCESS != COMMERCIAL MANDATE. Loss of a reasoning provider changes executor availability, not iSCOPE/PRI ownership, ledger state, or objective.
executor_continuity.active_truth: ACTIVE/ENABLED/SCHEDULER_WOKE != EXECUTING. EXECUTING requires current attributable continuing execution evidence.
executor_continuity.failure_response: If the configured reasoning executor is unavailable or fails required attributable work, Master restores/substitutes/reassigns an authorized executor without reopening OVERDRIVE or creating a second PRI.
executor_continuity.transport_truth: GitHub Actions/OVERDRIVE transport, READY claims and heartbeat commits do not substitute for reasoning or material commercial action.
executor_continuity.black_rule: BLACK remains capability expansion, not a required dependency.
